pages.text: Use a Staff Lanyard on a living creature to hire it. It stops, looks at you and stands $(l)awaiting assignment$() until a Time Clock of yours within 16 blocks takes it.

Its own mind is off: it never despawns, attacks nobody and works for you with its temperament kept as a quirk.$(br2)Hostiles first need wearing down to half their health. Babies, bosses, hosts, creepers, fish, bats, vexes and shulkers are not hired.
Someone else's pet or staff, and a village's iron golem, are not yours to poach. A golem you built is.$(br2)A player employs 24 at most; a clock takes 8.

$(l)Let go$(): $(k:key.sneak) and use a Clipboard on it, twice within 3 seconds. The lanyard comes back with a Form 45-S (and the Hard Hat). It serves 10 seconds' notice, head down, then it is a creature again.

A Security colleague sees it out. A hostile is hostile again once the notice is up.$(br2)Turret Pedestals, iron golems and wolves spare staff, unless staff start it.$(br2)$(o)Wear your badge at all times. It is how we know you are staff.$()
